rows.label: tlk70000029_05_msg0001
rows.name:
I've lived a long life, but never
thought I'd see Iira in its awakened
form...

rows.label: tlk70000029_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I expect the road ahead of you will
be long and hard, and there is little
an old man like me can do to help.

rows.label: tlk70000029_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I can calm and encourage those gripped
by fear. So please don't worry about
us.

rows.label: tlk70000029_05_msg0004
rows.name:
There are people here who believe in
the king and in you. We may not be
warriors but we're not powerless!

rows.label: tlk70000029_05_msg0005
rows.name: Please be careful. We must meet again.
